India questions WhatsApp username feature over fraud risks

The Indian government has issued notices to WhatsApp and other messaging platforms like Telegram and Signal regarding their new username features. The Centre has raised concerns that these usernames could increase the risk of cyber fraud and impersonation, prompting a request for WhatsApp to pause its rollout. Meta has reportedly met with the IT ministry and is expected to file a response.
